about_short_description.short_description: Masry Market is an online store that retails housewares, personal care, food products, detergents and paper products.

product.name: Housewares
product.description: Items used for household purposes including kitchenware, cookware, and home accessories.

product.name: Personal Care Products
product.description: Products for personal hygiene and grooming including skincare, haircare, and related items.

product.name: Food Products
product.description: Various edible goods including packaged foods and groceries for household consumption.

product.name: Detergents
product.description: Cleaning agents used for laundry and household cleaning purposes.

product.name: Paper Products
product.description: Household paper goods such as tissues, napkins, and paper towels for daily use.
